shots.vo: An airplane window has three panes. The hole is in the middle one.

shots.vo: At thirty-five thousand feet, the cabin is pressurised and the air outside is thin.

shots.vo: The hole lets that pressure reach the outer pane, so the outer pane carries the load.

shots.vo: And if the outer pane ever fails, the middle pane is still there, ready to hold the cabin pressure.
